items.statement: Within the isolated-molecule computational boundary, the submitted energy and state-character evidence supports an HLCT interpretation and is consistent with access to higher-triplet (“hot”) channels, while not proving the full experimental photophysical mechanism.
items.expected: The conclusion explicitly links mixed LE/CT diagnostics and the higher-state energy pattern to the qualitative HLCT/high-RISC hypothesis and states the model limitation.

items.statement: Method, geometry/conformer and gas-phase assumptions limit direct numerical comparability and mechanistic certainty.
items.expected: The report distinguishes computational support from experimental proof and records relevant sensitivity/coverage limitations.
